script: Imagine a single bra worth over 475 Crore – that’s half a billion dollars. This isn't just fabric; it's a legendary masterpiece. We're talking about the Victoria's Secret Red Hot Fantasy Bra. It was truly adorned with over 1,300 precious stones, including a staggering 300 carats of Thai rubies. Originally valued at 15 million dollars back in the year 2000, that's equivalent to roughly 475 Crore in today's currency. This insane creation even holds a Guinness World Record! It was never truly meant for public sale, but rather to showcase extreme luxury and unparalleled craftsmanship. Can you believe an item of clothing could be worth more than a private jet? Imagine a single bra worth over 475 Crore – that’s half a billion dollars.
